_about.what: Machine-readable section library for premium SaaS / AI-SaaS marketing sites: section -> variants -> {count, structure spec, measured ranges, references, crop}. Source study: knowledge/web/section-anatomy.md (SA-01..SA-48) and knowledge/web/footers.md (FT-01..FT-20).

sample.note: counts are homepages out of 43 unless the section says pages; posthog (desktop-OS homepage) excluded; openai not captured (human-verification wall)

_about.units: px at 1440 viewport unless stated; ranges are [p25, p75] unless marked range
_about.use: Pick a variant per section in DIRECTION.md; prefer the second-most-common variant when the last build used the dominant one (founder range rule).

order.fixed_start: hero -> logos (32/43 immediately; 37/38 walls in position 2-3)
order.fixed_end: testimonials (median position 0.75) -> closing CTA (28/43 last section; +5 merged into footer)

ink_strip.structure: full-bleed 40-48px strip, ink fill, white 13-14px text + one link/arrow, nav docks under it

brand_colour_strip.structure: full-bleed strip in the brand colour, white or ink 14-16px text

quiet_canvas_strip.structure: strip one step off the canvas, muted 14-18px text

floating_pill_or_subrow.structure: pill floating at top 8px or a row under the nav

hero_attached_row.structure: one row of 6-10 mono logos on the hero bottom edge, 14px caption or none

single_row.structure: one row of 6-12 logos on the canvas below the hero, optional 14-20px caption

two_row_grid.structure: 2 rows x 6 logos, centred, 14-18px caption above

marquee_edge_fade.structure: infinite row with 80-160px edge masks; pause on hover; static under reduced motion

headline_led_wall.structure: a 42-160px claim with a real number, then the wall (rows or a dark band)

tile_grid.structure: equal tiles 3-5% off canvas, r4-12, gap 8-12; logo centred

hairline_cell_grid.structure: 5x2 or 6x3 cells divided by 1px rules, optional corner arrow to the story

two_tone_lead.structure: one paragraph, one size 28-48px; first sentence ink, rest ~55% ink

display_or_serif_statement.structure: centred 40-56px statement in the brand display face, 2-3 lines

highlighted_phrase.structure: statement with 2-3 phrases on a tinted highlight

inline_icon_sentence.structure: one sentence with product/app icons set inline in the text

problem_reframe.structure: pain named once in the heading or as a chaos visual, answered in the same block

us_vs_them_block.structure: two columns: other tools (crosses) vs us (checks); templates only

full_width_chapter.structure: heading 48px in a 380-560px left column, body/two-tone in the right column, full-container media below, 3 small sub-features under it

alternating_rows.structure: text 420-520px / media 600-700px, sides alternate, media top-aligned with heading, 64-96px between rows

centred_stack.structure: centred heading + one-line sub over a centred UI, repeated

colour_panel_rows.structure: each feature in a tinted or carded panel with its own art

numbered_or_rail_chapters.structure: chapters numbered 01/02/03 or joined by a left progress rail

pill_row_above_panel.structure: 3-6 pills (32-40px) centred above one fixed-size panel; first active

vertical_list_beside_panel.structure: list of 4-5 tab labels (title + 1-line body for the active one) left, panel right

icon_columns.structure: 3 icon+title+body columns act as tabs above a shared screenshot

carousel_selector.structure: a horizontal carousel of visual items; the centred item is the selection

timeline_tabs.structure: product tabs over a 3-point timeline (Today / Hours later / Tomorrow)

three_numbered_cards.structure: 3 equal cards 01/02/03, each with a mini UI

timeboxed_columns.structure: 3 columns headed by elapsed time with checklists

process_slider.structure: one step per slide with step counter; templates only

numbered_sticky_list.structure: left numbered list (inactive ~40% ink), right sticky visual swapping per step

sticky_nav_list.structure: left sticky nav list of capabilities, right scrolling content

sticky_text_stacked_visuals.structure: left sticky text, right column of 5-6 stacked product visuals

accordion_with_visual.structure: left accordion of capabilities, right visual for the open one

catalogue.structure: 6-8 small icon tiles (title + 1 line) in a 3-4 column grid, often after a bento

ruled_centred_row.structure: heading, then 3-4 numbers in one row with hairline dividers

split_heading_stat_grid.structure: heading + copy left, 2x2 or 3-up numbers right

live_counter.structure: numbers from the product API, ticking (split-flap or mono)

chart_backed.structure: numbers over or beside a real growth chart

stat_cells_in_bento.structure: numbers as cells inside a bento or panel

masonry_wall.structure: 3 columns of uneven quote cards (r12-16, pad 20-24, hairline), 9-16 quotes, "show more" or fade

portrait_photo_cards.structure: quote over or beside a large portrait or video still

carousel.structure: one quote at a time (24-25px) with arrows, optional 2 metrics and photo

single_big_quote.structure: one centred quote 28-56px, name and role under, no card

marquee_row.structure: row of 14px quote cards scrolling with edge fade

video_led.structure: one large video testimonial card + 2 quote cards

logo_tab_switcher.structure: company names as tabs; selected shows photo + 36px quote + case link

centre_focus_carousel.structure: 3-up carousel, centre card emphasised, edges faded (second section on cal)

logo_tabs_photo_metric.structure: logo tabs; selected shows photo + one metric + story link

featured_carousel.structure: one large featured story card + smaller cards, arrows

photo_cards.structure: 4 portrait or brand-colour cards with logo and metric

editorial_feature.structure: one story told as an editorial spread

logo_led_quote_cards.structure: 3 cards led by the customer logo, quote, person

page_featured_plus_grid.structure: customers page: featured story + grid or list rows with filters

page_logo_tile_grid.structure: customers page: 3-col logo tiles, each a story

page_filterable_cards.structure: customers page: filter selects + 3-col cards (+ stat row)

icon_grid_beside_copy.structure: copy left, 2x4 to 4x4 grid of 32-48px partner marks right

orbit_around_mark.structure: partner marks on an orbit/arc around the product mark

logo_tiles_row.structure: one row of partner tiles under a statement

sdk_tabs_code.structure: SDK/language icon tabs over a live code block

systems_collage.structure: collage of the tools being replaced/connected

page_directory.structure: integrations page: search + category sidebar/chips + card grid

page_marketing_tiles.structure: integrations page: hero + featured tiles + categories

card_grid.structure: 3-6 cards: icon or visual, control name, one line; badges for held certifications

badge_strip_or_statement.structure: row of seals with one statement line

framework_carousel.structure: cards per framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR) with arrows

dark_panel.structure: one dark rounded panel: heading, paragraph, link

page_compliance_table.structure: requirement / status pill / scope / evidence link table

page_trust_center.structure: trust center with overview, compliance, controls, subprocessors

page_section_stack.structure: hero + sections per area with badges

page_policy_doc.structure: long-form policy with a table of contents

separate_cards_one_highlighted.structure: 3-5 equal-height cards, gap 12-24, r8-20, one highlighted + badge, CTAs on one baseline

ruled_grid.structure: plans share 1px rules, no gaps, r0; highlight by fill/raise

grouped_plan_families.structure: tabs or rows per product/audience, each with its own plans

calculator_slider.structure: volume/seat slider or team-size input drives the price

usage_tables.structure: pay-as-you-go resource tables or usage chart

homepage_teaser.structure: 3 cards or teaser cells on the homepage, then FAQ, then CTA

full_grid_sticky_header.structure: sticky plan header (name, price, CTA), grouped rows, check/dash cells

collapsible_groups.structure: groups as accordions; open one by default

head_to_head.structure: us vs them, our column a highlighted card inside the table

compare_hub.structure: cards per competitor + switching quotes + promise letter

centred_accordion.structure: single column 700-860px, hairline rows 56-72px, chevron/plus right, "more questions" link below

split_heading_left.structure: heading (and contact link) in a 280-420px left column, accordion right; can group by category

filled_rows.structure: each question in a filled rounded row (r16-42)

open_grid.structure: all answers visible in 3 columns, no accordion

bare_centred_statement.structure: 48-76px centred heading (often the hero promise), 1-2 buttons, page canvas

colour_or_photo_band.structure: full-bleed brand colour, gradient or photo band; heading + button

art_panel.structure: signature art (collage, 3D, illustration) behind or beside the heading

input_cta.structure: prompt box or email field as the action

split_text_product.structure: text + button left, product image right (or a pill strip)

gradient_panel_with_proof.structure: soft gradient panel, buttons, rating badges under

inline_row_under_changelog.structure: 14px line + email + Subscribe under the changelog strip

header_control_on_changelog_blog.structure: subscribe/RSS control in the changelog or blog header

home_four_entry_row.structure: 4 entries in a row: date (12-13px mono/muted), title 14-16px, excerpt, View all

home_split_timeline.structure: heading + link left, vertical timeline of 5 entries right

home_card_carousel.structure: image cards of recent launches with arrows

page_date_gutter_feed.structure: date in a left gutter, 560-760px entry column, cover art or UI per entry, subscribe in header

page_weekly_card_grid.structure: 3-col grid of weekly cards with art

page_compact_list.structure: list rows (date, title, excerpt) expanding inline

page_week_covers.structure: feed with a large week-number cover per week

home_three_cards.structure: 3-4 cards with thumbnails or tinted text cards

page_featured_plus_grid.structure: featured post + 3-col card grid + category tabs

page_featured_plus_list.structure: featured + dense list/table (date, category, title, author)

culture_led.structure: mission h1, film/team photo, values 4-6, perks, open roles list with filters

jobs_board_first.structure: short intro, then roles list with filters

founder_letter.structure: signed letter from the founder above roles

brand_column_plus_columns.structure: brand column 300-430px (logo, tagline, socials, status) + 3-6 link columns from x 420-560; legal row

full_width_grid.structure: 4-12 groups across the container; logo in the bottom row, as a giant wordmark, or absent

cta_merged.structure: closing CTA opens the footer on the same surface; links below

inset_panel.structure: rounded panel (r16-48) inset in a coloured or art frame

giant_wordmark.structure: brand SVG 65-100% of viewport width, 130-320px tall, flat or 4-8% faded, 0-48px from bottom or bleeding

illustrated_or_animated.structure: signature art as a top strip, a 200-300px bottom band, or a scene behind an inset panel

cta_merged_any_layout.structure: heading 28-48px + button or input at the top of the footer

inset_rounded_panel.structure: panel radius matches the page frame

newsletter_row.structure: one row: what/how often + 36-44px email + Subscribe

live_status_pill.structure: 6-8px dot + "All systems operational" 12-13px, links to status page

status_link.structure: plain Status link in the sitemap

socials.structure: 16-20px mono icons in brand column or bottom row

language_selector.structure: select or button in the bottom row/brand column

compliance.structure: mono seals 24-40px or one 12-13px text line

app_badges.structure: App Store / Google Play / platform chips / QR

featured_content.structure: announcement cards or a quote inside the footer
